summary: Maintainers need to understand the two-level caching system (lru_cache + SettingsManager dict), the validate_assignment=True invariant and its object.__setattr__ workaround, the SettingsParameters structural-vs-runtime split, the __pydantic_init_subclass__ dynamic field installation in DescriptorProfile, and the secrets resolution pipeline.

concepts.name: Two-level caching architecture
recommended_docs: lru_cache on _get_settings() — unbounded, process-global
SettingsManager dict as secondary store
apply_runtime_overrides() returns model_copy() — cached instance is never mutated

concepts.name: SettingsParameters structural/runtime split
recommended_docs: Custom __hash__/__eq__ exclude kwargs — structural params only
merge() field-by-field strategies (union, last-wins, dict-merge)
apply_runtime_overrides() for post-cache kwargs application

concepts.name: validate_assignment=True and object.__setattr__ invariant
recommended_docs: All setattr triggers pydantic validation — SecretStr wrapping, enum coercion, AfterValidator
SETTINGS_SOURCE_* fields use object.__setattr__ to bypass revalidation and model_fields_set tracking
Design doc: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-18-setattr-bypass-fix-design.md

concepts.name: DescriptorProfile dynamic field installation
recommended_docs: __pydantic_init_subclass__ fires at class creation — mutates model_fields and __annotations__
model_rebuild(force=True) required after dynamic annotation changes
auth discriminated union assembled from descriptor.auth_modes list

concepts.name: Secrets resolution pipeline
recommended_docs: Resolution runs twice in __init__: once on kwargs before super().__init__, once on model fields after
resolve_references_in_dict for kwargs; resolve_references_in_model_tree for loaded config fields
Nested BaseModel fields are rebuilt as new instances to avoid frozen=True mutation

concepts.name: Config file dispatch pipeline
recommended_docs: Files separated by extension into SettingsFiles (env/yaml/toml/json)
yaml_file/toml_file/json_file set on model_config before super().__init__
settings_customise_sources() returns source priority tuple

concepts.name: Known risks and change areas
recommended_docs: model_config mutation before super().__init__ is class-level — thread-safety risk under concurrent construction
SettingsManager dict cache is not thread-safe for concurrent first-creation
Dynamic pydantic field installation via model_rebuild() may need update on pydantic upgrades
